def VTask.evenOddRec : {P : ℕ → Sort u_1} -> (h0 : P 0) -> (h_even : (n : ℕ) → P n → P (2 * n)) -> (h_odd : (n : ℕ) → P n → P (2 * n + 1)) -> (n : ℕ) -> P n := fun (P : ℕ → Sort u_1) (h0 : P 0) (h_even : (n : ℕ) → P n → P (2 * n)) (h_odd : (n : ℕ) → P n → P (2 * n + 1)) (n : ℕ) ↦
  let bin := digits 2 n
  let base := h0
  let even_step := fun n' p ↦ h_even n' p
  let odd_step := fun n' p ↦ h_odd n' p
  let result := bin.foldl (fun p d ↦ if d = 0 then even_step n' p else odd_step n' p) base
  result
